description: This file defines a DockerExecutor class for managing Docker-based testing workflows, including cloning repositories, building Docker images, running tests with coverage, and handling GitHub app authentication. It also includes related data classes and a main function demonstrating usage.

classes.name: TestCoverageItem
classes.description: Data class representing test coverage details, including coverage percentage and missing lines.

classes.name: PytestOutput
classes.description: Class encapsulating the output of pytest runs, including coverage data and raw output.

classes.name: DockerExecutor
classes.description: Main class for executing Docker-based tests, including repository cloning, container building, and test execution.

methods.name: _generate_jwt
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for GitHub app authentication.

methods.name: _get_installation_access_token
methods.description: Retrieves an installation access token from GitHub using a JWT.

methods.name: _clone_repository
methods.description: Clones a GitHub repository using an access token.

methods.name: _build_container
methods.description: Builds a Docker container from a specified Dockerfile.

methods.name: _run_tests_and_get_coverage
methods.description: Runs tests inside a Docker container and retrieves coverage data.

methods.name: _create_files
methods.description: Creates new files in the repository directory.

methods.name: execute_with_new_files
methods.description: Main method to clone repo, add files, build container, and run tests with coverage.
